description: This file contains unit tests for credit-related utility functions: getCreditsPerUsd, usdToCredits, and formatCredits, verifying their behavior under different conditions.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Returns the current credit rate per USD, defaults if environment variable is not set.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits and rounds the result.

methods.name: formatCredits
methods.description: Formats a credits amount as a human-readable string with suffix.
